name: LaCroix Sparkling Water (Pamplemousse / Grapefruit WARNING)
whyItWorks: Intense carbonic acid fizz expands in the stomach and small intestine, causing painful gaseous distension, hiccups, and bloating. Grapefruit oil essences can irritate tender esophagus and gastric linings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active flares. If drinking in remission, pour over ice and let sit for 10 minutes to decarbonate.
